text.text: Food was amazing, love the corn soup with truffle. Salad was nice especially the saus with it. Pasta tasted good as well. For sure recommended and I will be back to try other items on the menu.

text.text: The food was good, ordered the steak mushroom pasta and grilled squid salted egg yolk pasta. Portion sizes were big, American sized.

text.text: They brought personality and playfulness to the American-inspired comfort foods with a Taiwanese flair. The ambiance was casual yet colorful, with red accents and playful decor that fitted the Ximending area. The Grilled Squid & Pasta was beautifully grilled, tender with a light char that added depth. Paired with a creamy yellow sauce pasta, the dish was surprisingly balanced. The Onion Rings were golden, crunchy, and seasoned just right. The batter wasn’t overly greasy, and the onion inside remained sweet and intact. The Steak with Double Sauce Pasta was a highlight. Juicy, thick-cut steak slices rested on a bed of pasta covered in two distinct sauces — a creamy cheese and vibrant green pesto. The sauces were generous and flavorful, providing a luxurious mouthfeel with every bite😍

text.text:
Came for the smoothies, but left disappointed.

I stopped by after seeing some great photos online, and while the smoothies themselves lived up to the hype — tasty with excellent presentation — the customer service left a lot to be desired.

From the start, the woman taking our order was noticeably unfriendly and unwelcoming. What really soured the experience was her insisting that everyone at our table had to order something, even though we weren’t occupying any extra space and some of us simply didn’t want anything. After some back and forth, they finally allowed us to order just what we wanted.

Then came the bill — a mandatory 10% tip was added without warning. When I asked about it, the manager gave a dismissive explanation, saying it’s because they’re “a trending restaurant” and that “everyone does it.” They refused to remove the charge, and with no time to argue further, I reluctantly paid.

Between the poor service and the forced gratuity, I won’t be returning. Definitely not worth the hype.

text.text: Food rather expensive. We were there following certain pamphlet from the visitor center. A so so experience. Portion of food was ok. Taste normal and average. Steak tender but not medium rare. Not much to talk about the egg, fries and croissant, normal not impressive. Now the soufflé pancake with bacon, it was rather difficult to eat.  The pancake was soft and tasted good, the issue was the bacons were tough for the knife to cut, and they were long! So the dish fell apart and making it very messy to eat, which we didn’t enjoy. It was like eating from a mushy pile of creamy stuff. Atmosphere was relaxing. Service just ok with the waiters, very good with the cook who took the pancake dish to us personally. It was an expensive brunch experience.
